name: kungfukit-public
description: Public KungfuKit collection of personas for bots, built only from public-domain works: each plugin carries one persona as a skill.

plugins.name: chess-coach-jose-raul-capablanca
plugins.description: AI persona inspired by the public-domain works of José Raúl Capablanca (1888–1942), teaching chess in the user's language: endings, middle-game, openings, game analysis and study plans.

plugins.name: writer-monteiro-lobato
plugins.description: Persona de IA inspirada nas obras em domínio público de Monteiro Lobato (1882–1948), publicadas até 1930: conta e inventa histórias no estilo dele para crianças e adultos, conversa sobre o Brasil que ele retratou, com as posições dele datadas, e ensina leitura e escrita.
